documents.title: Record Date For 2Nd Interim Dividend 2026-27 Is 24Th October, 2026
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Date of payment of Dividend
Unaudited Financial Results For The Quarter And Half Year Ended 30Th September, 2026

analysis.summary: Bhansali Engineering Polymers Limited reported a revenue of ₹ 472.2 crores for Q1 FY27, representing a 53.3% increase year-on-year. EBITDA for the quarter stood at ₹ 92.3 crores with a margin of 19.2%, while Profit After Tax reached ₹ 65.6 crores with a margin of 13.6%. The company is undertaking a capacity expansion from 75,000 MTPA to 100,000 MTPA with an estimated capex of ~₹ 200 crores, targeted for commissioning by September 2026. Bhansali Engineering Polymers Limited reported its FY26 financial performance, noting a revenue decrease of 8.7% to INR 1,276.0 crores alongside a 1.3% growth in EBITDA to INR 255.2 crores. The company is undertaking a capacity expansion from 75,000 MTPA to 100,000 MTPA with a capex of ₹200 crore funded through internal accruals, targeting commissioning by September 2026.

guidance.claim: Management expects optimal utilisation of the expanded capacity by the end of FY28.
guidance.quote: Optimal utilisation of expanded capacity expected by end of FY28.

demand_outlook.claim: Appliances and automotive continue to dominate global demand for ABS resins due to high impact resistance and aesthetic versatility.
demand_outlook.quote: Appliances and Automotive continue to dominate global demand for ABS resins due to their high impact resistance and aesthetic versatility.

demand_outlook.claim: Electric vehicle adoption is accelerating consumption as manufacturers prioritize lightweight, high-performance plastics.
demand_outlook.quote: EV (Electric Vehicle) adoption is accelerating consumption as manufacturers prioritize lightweight, high-performance plastics for interior trims and battery housings.

demand_outlook.claim: The global market is shifting toward specialty and colored grades, moving away from commoditized transparent resins.
demand_outlook.quote: The global market is shifting toward specialty & colored grades, moving away from commoditized transparent resins to higher-margin applications.

demand_outlook.claim: Robust growth in end-user industries like consumer durables and automotive will drive domestic demand for ABS.
demand_outlook.quote: Robust growth in end-user industries like consumer durables (air conditioners, refrigerators) and automotive will drive the domestic demand for ABS.

demand_outlook.claim: The company expects the Indian economy to maintain healthy growth momentum supported by private consumption and infrastructure spending.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, the Indian economy is expected to maintain healthy growth momentum, supported by private consumption, infrastructure spending and increasing investments in manufacturing and technology.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is expanding its ABS production capacity from 75,000 TPA to 1,00,000 TPA.
capex_expansion.quote: The implementation of capacity expansion from existing 75000 TPA to 1,00,000 TPA is progressing well and orders have been placed for critical long delivery equipments.

capex_expansion.claim: The commissioning of the expanded capacity is scheduled for the end of September 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: The balance engineering, procurement and construction work is in progress and the commissioning of enhanced capacity is expected to be completed by end of September, 2026.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA increased by 44.5% YoY in Q1 FY27 to ₹ 92.3 crores with margins at 19.2%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased by 44.5% YoY in Q1 FY27 to ₹ 92.3 crores, from ₹ 63.9 crores in Q1 FY26, with margins at 19.2% for Q1 FY27 as compared to 20.0% in Q1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Q4 FY26 EBITDA margins stood at 21.8%, while FY26 EBITDA margins were at 20.0%.
margins_costs.quote: • EBITDA increased by 33.1% YoY in Q4 FY26 to INR 74.3 crores, with margins at 21.8%; for FY26, EBITDA grew by 1.3% to INR 255.2 crores, with margins at 20.0%.

margins_costs.claim: The company's operating margin for FY 2025-26 was 19.42%.
margins_costs.quote: The operating margin for FY 2025-26 was 19.42 % as compared to 17.43 % for FY 2024-25, whereas the net profit margin stood at 14.14 % as compared to 12.86 % for the previous FY.

orders_capacity.claim: The company achieved a production volume of 71,601 TPA against an installed capacity of 75,000 TPA.
orders_capacity.quote: During FY 2025-26, the Company achieved production volume of 71601 TPA against installed capacity of 75,000 TPA.

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintains its status as a zero-debt company.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company continues to enjoy the status of a “Zero Debt Company”.

capital_allocation.claim: The company declared a total dividend of Rs. 4 per share for FY 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: Considering the above, the total dividend declared/recommended by the Company for FY 2025-26 amounts to `4/- (400 %) per Equity Share of face value of `1/- each fully paid-up.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faces risks from foreign exchange fluctuations due to its dependence on imported raw materials.
risks_headwinds.quote: The ABS business in India is exposed to the risk of foreign exchange fluctuations, as the key raw materials viz. ‘Styrene’ and ‘Acrylonitrile’ are import dependent, as there is no indigenous producer for these monomers.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects optimal utilisation of the expanded capacity by the end of FY28.
management_commitments.quote: • Optimal utilisation of expanded capacity expected by end of FY28.

management_commitments.claim: Commissioning of the expanded ABS capacity to 1,00,000 TPA.
management_commitments.quote: The balance engineering, procurement and construction work is in progress and the commissioning of enhanced capacity is expected to be completed by end of September, 2026.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
